summary.en: The caret becomes a seam; the input on one side, its result on the other; pick, pair, run and measure; one changed line takes the frame over; the seam closes.
summary.zh: 光标变成接缝；一边是输入，另一边是结果；挑选、配对、运行并测量；改一行占满画面；接缝合上。

fits: Launches of a product whose input maps line by line to its output: a generator, a compiler, a config-driven renderer, a CLI with a report. 16–36 s.
notFor: Products without a visible output; model launches argued from tables.

intent.en: Tell the launch as edits: every change is a move of one seam between what is written and what it makes.
intent.zh: 把发布讲成一次次编辑：每个变化都是同一道接缝在“写下的”和“做出的”之间移动。

content.en: A request, a list with 2–4 results, 2–6 file lines with their frames, a command with its frames and report, one changed line with two renders, an install line and a page.
content.zh: 一行请求、带 2–4 个结果的列表、2–6 行文件代码及其画格、一条命令及其画格和报告、一行改动及两张渲染、一行安装命令和一个页面。

fits.zh: 输入与输出逐行对应的产品的发布：生成器、编译器、由配置驱动的渲染器、带报告的命令行。16–36 秒。

notFor.zh: 没有可见输出的产品；用表格论证的模型发布。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
